summary: Bush-fringed summit overflow car park, only restaurants nearby, no homes.
reasons: Connected to main summit car park

drivers.seclusion: Trees on three sides; nearest buildings are the Summit restaurant and cafe, 20 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Joins the main summit car park and the loop road; cars already parked there, room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Summit road loops around the north and east edges; van stands clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Tourist car park with day visitors; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep elsewhere: edge grades up to 50% at the bank
Restaurant activity and evening visitors likely
sun_shade: Patchy tree shade across the lot, mostly from the north and east; open to western sun.

best_section.where: Southern edge of the upper car park, above the main summit lot
